data.name: Lutah
data.gender_notes: Lutah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Lutah is derived from the Arabic word ‘Al-Tuffah’ which means a small hill of stones or a cluster of stones. It is also associated with the flowing water and the desert. In Islamic traditions, the name Lutah is believed to be a reminder of the Prophet Loot (Lut) who was a righteous prophet and was known for his hospitality towards the travelers and his love for stones.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes resilience, strength, and the ability to overcome adversity. It is also a reminder of the importance of hospitality and kindness towards others.
data.etymology: Lutah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Stone, Flowing water.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lutah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
